newsitem.title: USA: Great Train aims to add 12-14 stores in '97.
newsitem.headline: Great Train aims to add 12-14 stores in '97.

text.p: The Great Train Store Co is negotiating leases aimed at adding about 12 to 14 new stores in 1997, the company said, adding that its 1997 growth plans include investigating possible acquisitions.

The company, which is a national chain of train-themed toy, hobby and gift stores, said its 1997 growth plans also include opening new stores around the United States and operating temporary "Christmas stores".
It said it will focus its acquisitions on existing train hobby stores, although it will consider a variety of other possible model train and railroad related entities.
